title: SKIP_STEP: refund/complete accepted with no prior pending refund request
unsupported_reason: This tests workflow-order enforcement (UIR-002: 'Complete refund' is only ever shown after a refund has been requested). If the server wrongly accepts completion with no prior request, order.refund.status will still read 'completed' and totalReturned will equal originalAmount (100), the same values as a legitimate single-request-then-complete flow. sum_lte(totalReturned <= originalAmount) is 100<=100=true in BOTH the buggy and the correct case, so it cannot distinguish an improperly-accepted skip-step from a valid completion. This requires manual/human review of order.refund.status and order.history to confirm no refund was ever requested before completion succeeded.
